title: Layer-cake comparison of radial cutoff integrals from a ball bound
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let ν and μ be measures on ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), let x ∈ ℝ^N, ρ0, Λ, A, t ∈ ℝ and φ : ℝ → ℝ. Assume: ν(B_r(x)) ≤ ofReal(Λ)·μ(B_r(x)) for every r with 0 < r < ρ0, where B_r(x) = closedBall x r; φ is continuous; φ is antitone (non-increasing); φ(s) = 1 for every s ≤ 1; φ(s) = 0 for every s ≥ A²; A > 0; t > 0; t·A < ρ0. Then ∫⁻ ofReal(φ(|y − x|²/t²)) dν(y) ≤ ofReal(Λ)·∫⁻ ofReal(φ(|y − x|²/t²)) dμ(y), the integrals being lower Lebesgue integrals with values in [0,∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ν μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (ρ₀ Λ A t : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ₀ → ν (closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ * μ (closedBall x r)) → Continuous φ → Antitone φ → (∀ s : ℝ, s ≤ 1 → φ s = 1) → (∀ s : ℝ, A ^ 2 ≤ s → φ s = 0) → 0 < A → 0 < t → t * A < ρ₀ → ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (φ (‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2)) ∂ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (φ (‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2)) ∂μ
